summary: Completed frontend-only final regression on public preview URL for navigation, hero transition, and timeline controls. Core user-facing requirements pass; no blocking frontend defect reproduced in stabilized runs.
action_items: No blocking fixes required from this regression run.
Optional: keep a small post-open menu delay in automated UI tests to avoid animation-timing click misses.
critical_code_review_comments: SeasonTimeline keydown listener effect has no dependency array, so listener is re-bound on each render; consider stabilizing with dependencies/useCallback for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://lewis-victories.preview.emergentagent.com. Fresh-state desktop checks: Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories menu links align target sections at viewport top. Hero logo returns to top. Hero scene minimizes through scroll and LEWIS/HAMILTON remain opposite-sided during transition. Timeline wheel does not change year; buttons and keyboard arrows change exactly one year. Mobile long-runway navigation also passed in repeated 3/3 runs for previously flaky targets when menu animation settle time is respected.
rca of the issue: Initial inconsistent results were reproduced when clicking menu targets immediately after opening panel or without ensuring button visibility in smaller viewport runs, leaving menu open and scrollY unchanged. After allowing menu animation to settle and ensuring target button is in view, destination jumps were deterministic across repeated runs.
